serialization.numbers: strict JSON integers only; bool allowed only in boolean fields
serialization.text: Unicode NFC normalized at validated input; reject control characters except newline in description/source_text

request_body_hash.payload: entire validated request JSON including explicit nullable fields
request_body_hash.note: GET not idempotent-store; path and method belong to scope. All POST/PATCH DTO fields required.

payload.terms: array ordered ASCII sku: sku,price_minor,active,ready_in_days,units_per_pack,terms_revision; title excluded

catalog_terms_hash.note: For FIXED includes all offer lines; BUNDLE all candidate SKU in approved template. Stock is excluded. Terms revision changes only on price, active or ready_in_days; title and stock changes excluded; pack units immutable.

solution_hash.note: Hash does not replace server lookup, buyer binding or permission validation.
